intro: Lesson 82: Prime factor decomposition. To understand how to write a number as a product of its prime factors

blocks.text: Write the number at the top. Split it into two factors, circle the primes, and keep going until every branch ends in a prime.

questions.q: Write as products of primes in index form: (a) 48 (b) 90 (c) 126 (d) 200
Use prime factors to decide whether 1,764 is a square number.
questions.a: 1,764 = 2² × 3² × 7²: all powers even, so it is 42²

questions.q: What is the smallest number you could multiply 72 by to make a square number?
Big question: why only one way?
questions.a: Every number breaks down into primes, and the set of primes is always the same however you split it.
